name: Aiko Imai
source:
Amimi’s Mom: A shining beacon of optimism and cheer that hopes to rub that off on her child, even if her demeanor is grounded in realism. Currently separated from her husband. A hotel specialist by career now helping manage a small, sit-down restaurant in the new city to make ends meet.

[From [url=https://www.tsofgame.com/characters]official website[/url]]
